steps.say: The coefficient on $x$ is [[b]] and the constant inside is $[[c_signed]]^{\circ}$, so the shift is found by asking where the argument reaches zero.
Setting the argument to zero, $[[inner]] = 0$, leaves $[[b]]x = [[c_signed]]^{\circ}$.
Dividing by the coefficient gives $x = [[value]]^{\circ}$, so the wave begins there: it is shifted [[shift]] degrees to the [[dir]].
A shift to the right counts as positive and a shift to the left as negative, so the signed phase shift is [[value]].

answer: So the phase shift is [[value]] degrees.
